description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/treasury/yield-curve (base $0.01; USDC on Base or Polygon); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with no parameters (latest published day), or ?date=YYYY-MM-DD. US Treasury daily par yield curve, 1-month to 30-year, plus 2s10s and 3-month/10-year spreads. Optional date=YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest day). Data credit: U.S. Department of the Treasury; not affiliated with or endorsed by the Treasury. Up to 30 minutes old. Informational only, no warranty; not advice. Bad input is refused before payment, not charged. If no curve exists for the date, it is refused and not charged; if any tenor returns data, the full price is charged. USDC on Base or Polygon. On USDC on Base, errors are not charged, apart from the exceptions noted on a route. On USDC on Solana, and RLUSD on the XRP Ledger, a refused or failed request may still be charged.
